purpose: Active execution packing for semantic CI obligations; production and scoped rehearsal must preserve this capability ownership.

fast-gate.note: Always-materialized static/validator/lint lane. Node contracts execute independently; build is packed with deep services.

deep-verification.note: Coverage-only implementation lane; expensive services are independently packed so they do not serialize behind covered Vitest.

deep-services.note: Impact-scoped build / solver-soundness / persistence lane. Build runs serially with service setup; proofs and Firestore remain concurrent. This packing reduces hosted-runner allocation without weakening any capability.

node-contracts.note: Two-runner Node/CLI matrix. Semantic selection is preserved; execution-owner filters partition the selected commands exactly once across research+solver+game+persistence and shared+data+repo.

finalStatus.note: Router, Fast Gate and Node matrix must succeed; coverage and combined build/deep-services may skip only when semantic routing selects none of their capabilities.
